summary: Practice session: 2714 rule versions tested on 11 coins, 2 of 12 setups in the playbook (Breakdown short, Downside momentum burst short).

setups.label: Trend pullback
setups.plain: Buy when the 1h trend is up, price dips back to the 20-bar average within the last 3 bars, RSI is at most 53 and the candle closes back above the average, only when BTC is trending up during Asia hours (08-16 SGT). Stop 2.7 ATR away, target 3R, stop to breakeven at +1R, exit after 8h if neither is hit.

setups.label: Rally fade in a downtrend
setups.plain: Sell short when the 1h trend is down, price dips back to the 20-bar average within the last 1 bars, RSI is at least 35 and the candle closes back below the average, only when BTC is trending down during Asia hours (08-16 SGT). Stop 2.8 ATR away, target 3.5R, stop to breakeven at +1R, exit after 6h if neither is hit.

setups.label: Breakout
setups.plain: Buy when price closes above the 32-bar (8h) high on 2.7x normal volume during Europe hours (16-24 SGT). Stop 2.9 ATR away, target 2.25R, stop to breakeven at +1R, exit after 1h if neither is hit.

setups.label: Breakdown
setups.plain: Sell short when price closes below the 72-bar (18h) low on 2.2x normal volume, only with the 1h trend down, only when BTC is trending down during Europe hours (16-24 SGT). Stop 2.5 ATR away, target 3.5R, exit after 12h if neither is hit.

setups.label: Opening-range breakout
setups.plain: Buy when price breaks above the first hour's high (opening range, 08:00 SGT) within 8h of the open on 2.7x normal volume, only with the 1h trend up, only when BTC is trending up. Stop 1.8 ATR away, target 4R, exit after 10h if neither is hit.

setups.label: Opening-range breakdown
setups.plain: Sell short when price breaks below the first hour's low (opening range, 08:00 SGT) within 3h of the open on 2.8x normal volume, only with the 1h trend down during Asia hours (08-16 SGT). Stop 1.7 ATR away, target 3.5R, exit after 9h if neither is hit.

setups.label: VWAP reclaim
setups.plain: Buy when price was below VWAP in the last 6 bars and closes back above it on 2.2x normal volume, only with the 1h trend up, only when BTC is trending up during US hours (00-08 SGT). Stop 2.8 ATR away, target 1.75R, stop to breakeven at +1R, exit after 8h if neither is hit.

setups.label: VWAP loss
setups.plain: Sell short when price was above VWAP in the last 4 bars and closes back below it on 2.5x normal volume during US hours (00-08 SGT). Stop 3 ATR away, target 1.75R, stop to breakeven at +1R, exit after 11h if neither is hit.

setups.label: Stop-hunt reversal at the lows
setups.plain: Buy when price pokes under the 88-bar low (stop hunt) and closes back inside, RSI at most 30 during US hours (00-08 SGT). Stop 2.8 ATR away, target 3.5R, stop to breakeven at +1R, exit after 5h if neither is hit.

setups.label: Stop-hunt reversal at the highs
setups.plain: Sell short when price pokes over the 64-bar high (stop hunt) and closes back inside, RSI at least 45, only when BTC is trending down. Stop 1.7 ATR away, target 4R, exit after 11h if neither is hit.

setups.label: Momentum burst
setups.plain: Buy when price has moved 3.25 ATR up in 2 bars on 1.9x volume during Europe and US hours (16-08 SGT). Stop 2.3 ATR away, target 4R, stop to breakeven at +1R, exit after 1h if neither is hit.

setups.label: Downside momentum burst
setups.plain: Sell short when price has moved 2.75 ATR down in 2 bars on 2.1x volume, only with the 1h trend down during Europe hours (16-24 SGT). Stop 2 ATR away, target 1.75R, exit after 2h if neither is hit.
